action.journal_reversal.description: Append exactly one generic reversal of a persisted posted original

output.description: Known committed source-shaped reversal result and optional native receipt

errors.refused: Source business refusal or strict native metadata/precision/authority/schema refusal; whole rollback; unknown commit withholds result

preconditions: Current human ledger.post permission and canonical admitted main company writer
Original evidence and policy loaded internally, never supplied as request flags
postconditions: Original header and lines unchanged; one new reversed header, swapped ordered lines, fiscal sequence/hash/retention and journal_reverse audit
Issued invoice/credit note generic reversal refused regardless apparent repair eligibility
No bank exception reopening/resolution; errors abort all effects; receipt replay still requires current authority
external_effects: New reversal header and swapped lines with source-derived raw VAT/text/FX metadata
Same company transaction allocates sequence, audit and optional stable-principal receipt; no product endpoint, migration or external mail
